title: Celebrate Billboard Latin Music Week with a Limited-Time SiriusXM Channel
summary: Hear music from this year’s finalists, performers, past winners, and more during Billboard Latin Music Week.
body_markdown:
Celebrate the biggest week in Latin music with SiriusXM’s limited-time Billboard Latin Music Week Channel, featuring music from this year’s biggest artists, Billboard Latin Music Awards finalists, past winners, and more.


[Billboard Latin Music Week Channel, Available October 16-October 22 on the app Listen on the App Listen on the App](https://sxm.app.link/BlogBillboardLatinMusicWeekChannel)


### **How to Listen**


The channel will stream exclusively on the[SiriusXM app](https://sxm.app.link/BlogBillboardLatinMusicWeekChannel) from October 16 through October 22 while also taking over[Hits Uno (Ch. 148)](https://www.siriusxm.com/channels/hits-uno) in the car from October 20 through October 22.


### **What You’ll Hear**


Hear hits from Billboard Latin Music Week and the Billboard Latin Music Awards presenters and finalists, including Shakira, Karol G, Prince Royce, Bad Bunny, Pitbull, Maluma, Fuerza Regida, Rawayana, Ryan Castro, and more.


The limited-time channel will also feature music from past Billboard Latin Music Awards winners and some of Latin music’s biggest stars.


### **Billboard Latin Music Awards Finalists Spotlight**


Also available exclusively on the SiriusXM app from October 16 through October 22 is the Billboard Latin Music Awards Finalists Spotlight, a one-hour special featuring select songs from some of this year’s finalists.


Hear music from Peso Pluma, Tito Double P, Fuerza Regida, Karol G, Prince Royce, Bad Bunny, and more.


The special will also be available to listen to on demand on the SiriusXM app.


### **Billboard Latin Music Awards**


The Billboard Latin Music Awards will air live from the James L. Knight Center in Miami on Thursday, October 22 at 8pm ET/7pm CT on Telemundo and Peacock.


Blue-carpet coverage begins at 7pm ET/6pm CT.


### **Billboard Latin Music Week**


Taking place October 19–22 in Miami Beach, Billboard Latin Music Week brings together artists, creators, executives, and fans for performances, panels, workshops, showcases, and other events celebrating Latin music.


Among this year’s events is Billboard En Vivo featuring Fuerza Regida, an exclusive performance at Miami’s Faena Theater on Tuesday, October 20.


SiriusXM listeners can register at a discounted rate for Latin Music Week by using promo code **SXM26** at[BillboardLatinMusicWeek.com](https://www.billboardlatinmusicweek.com/2026/tickets) .


On Wednesday, October 21, Billboard and Eater will also host the inaugural El Pre Party, followed by a Billboard En Vivo concert featuring Jay Wheeler, Zhamira, and special guest Conep.


SiriusXM listeners can use promo code SXM26 for a special discount when purchasing eligible tickets through Tickeri.
